# Alpha Nova

> Alpha Nova (also written AlphaNova) is a free browser-based research app for Indian and global markets. Canonical website: https://alphanova48.in/

Alpha Nova is also known as AlphaNova Terminal. Personal research is stored on the device; use Portfolio backup and restore to move it between browsers or websites.

The public guides explain the same rules used in the interactive product. Market data can be delayed or unavailable. Screens are research filters, not recommendations or predictions. Interactive matches require JavaScript; static guides do not publish current stock picks.

## Founder

AlphaNova was founded by Yash Sarda, based in Kolkata.

## Screener guides

- [Guide index](https://alphanova48.in/screens.html)
- [Delivery accumulation screener](https://alphanova48.in/screens/delivery-accumulation.html): Explore Alpha Nova’s NSE delivery accumulation screen: delivered quantity, delivery percentage and price-change rules, with examples and data limitations.
- [Volume surge stock screener](https://alphanova48.in/screens/volume-surge.html): Find how Alpha Nova screens for NSE volume surges: at least twice the prior 20-session average and a non-negative daily change, with a worked example.
- [20-day breakout stock screener](https://alphanova48.in/screens/20-day-breakout.html): Understand Alpha Nova’s 20-day breakout screen: NSE closing price above prior session highs with at least 1.3× volume, plus checks and limitations.
- [Near 52-week high stock screener](https://alphanova48.in/screens/near-52-week-high.html): See Alpha Nova’s near-52-week-high screen rules: within 3% of the highest available daily close and at least 1.5× volume, with calculation examples.
- [Relative strength stock screener](https://alphanova48.in/screens/relative-strength.html): Learn Alpha Nova’s relative strength screen: stock return minus Nifty 50 over 63 sessions, a 10-point threshold and non-negative one-month return.
- [Minervini trend template screener](https://alphanova48.in/screens/minervini-trend-template.html): Review Alpha Nova’s adapted Minervini trend template: moving-average structure, rising 200 DMA, high-low distance and the app’s composite score filter.

Documentation updated: 2026-10-03. This is not a market-data timestamp.
